summary: Verified DRUNK PIGEONS fat-label wording change + score-hud removal. Combined: (1) pure-function unit test of fatLevelFor/extraFatLevelFor over chip counts 0..500 covering every threshold, (2) code review of GameScreen render + config, (3) live UI smoke test at 390x844 mobile viewport confirming score-hud is absent, top HUD row intact, fat-label absent at 0 chips, Game Over overlay still shows DISTANCE/BEST DISTANCE/SCORE/BEST/CHIPS EATEN. Live-triggering 70+ chips is infeasible in-session (would require a dev hook, which the request forbids leaving in code); explicitly permitted as code-review confirmation.

verification_results.score_hud_removed_live: PASS - [data-testid="score-hud"] count=0 in READY state, during flap gameplay, and Game Over is still rendered (screenshot). Old unlabeled numeric HUD is gone as intended.
verification_results.top_hud_row_intact: PASS - restart-button, exit-button (< MENU), distance-hud (updates to 15m), chip-hud (0 with chip icon) all present and unchanged.
verification_results.fat_label_thresholds_original: PASS via unit exec of fatLevelFor/FAT_LABELS: 10=Slightly chunky, 20=Noticeably fat, 30=Very fat & struggling, 40=Ridiculously fat, 50=Ridiculously fat, 60=ABSOLUTE UNIT. testID='fat-label' correctly not rendered at chips<10 (verified live count=0 at 0 chips).
verification_results.fat_label_thresholds_new: PASS via unit exec of extraFatLevelFor/EXTRA_FAT_LABELS: 70=AIRSPACE VIOLATION, 80=NEEDS ITS OWN RUNWAY, 90=HAS ITS OWN POSTCODE, 100=LEGALLY A LANDMARK, 110=VISIBLE FROM SPACE. Cap verified: 150 and 500 still return VISIBLE FROM SPACE (extraLevel=5 clamped, never cycles/disappears).
verification_results.visual_size_cap: PASS via code review: PigeonView receives fatLevel = fatLevelFor(fatChipsCur), and fatLevelFor is Math.min(CONFIG.MAX_FAT_LEVEL=6, floor(chips/10)). pigeonSizeFor/pigeonRadiusFor both derive from same clamped fatLevel -> no drift between rendered size and hitbox. Not modified in this task.
verification_results.skinny_jab_decoupling: PASS via code review: onSkinnyJab resets fatChipsCur only; total 'chips' state (which drives extraFatLevelFor) is only reset inside startRun(). Render logic in GameScreen: extraLevel>0 branch takes precedence over fatLevel branch, so wording persists on AIRSPACE VIOLATION+ tier even after fatChipsCur is zeroed. Live triggering ~0.5% chance not feasible; behavior confirmed by code.
verification_results.revive_preserves_wording: PASS via code review: engine.revive keeps score/chips; startRun (which zeroes chips + fatChipsCur) is NOT invoked on revive path (only in onPlayAgain and confirmRestartNow).
verification_results.new_run_resets_wording: PASS via code review: startRun() sets setChips(0) and setFatChipsCur(0) -> both fatLevel and extraLevel become 0 -> fat-label element not rendered at all.
verification_results.game_over_overlay_unaffected: PASS live: Game Over overlay screenshot shows DISTANCE 15m, BEST DISTANCE 15m, SCORE 0, BEST 0, CHIPS EATEN 0, NEW BEST! banner; PLAY AGAIN / REVIVE / MAIN MENU buttons all present.
verification_results.no_console_errors: PASS - only benign warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (React Native Web deprecation, pre-existing, unrelated to this task).

critical_code_review_comments: GameScreen.js render is clean: `extraLevel > 0 ? EXTRA_FAT_LABELS[extraLevel-1] : (fatLevel > 0 && FAT_LABELS[fatLevel])` correctly implements precedence and never renders fat-label at 0 chips.

extraFatLevelFor in config.js: Math.max(0, Math.min(5, floor(totalChips/10) - 6)) correctly maps 60->0 (no extra tier yet), 70->1 through 110->5, and clamps 120+ to 5. Handles totalChips=null via `(totalChips||0)`.
Minor (pre-existing, not related): react-native-web pointerEvents deprecation warning appears once on load; consider migrating to style.pointerEvents in a future pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fat-label wording extension (old 6 tiers + 5 new tiers) and score-hud removal both verified. Old score-hud testID is intentionally gone; do not flag. Live 70+ chip runs are impractical without a temporary dev hook (forbidden by request); rely on pure-function verification + code review for those tiers. All top-HUD, distance, chip, and Game Over labels remain unchanged and correct.
